description: An Auburn native who served in President Donald Trump’s administration has been endorsed by the Republican chairs in the 22nd Congressional District to challenge Democratic U.S. Rep. John Mannion. The Republican leaders in Cayuga, Cortland, Madison, Oneida and Onondaga counties are supporting Kailee Buller, who was chief of staff to U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins […]
